description: The BotTest agent is designed to ingest file-based data (like Excel and PDB files) and web-sourced information (such as Wikipedia historical estimates and scientific papers). It executes Python/Biopython code for parsing and computations, including calculating distances, velocities, and percentages. The agent filters and aggregates data based on specified criteria (e.g., beak lengths and food categories) and outputs formatted numerical results with the required precision and units.

tools.description: Facilitates browsing and downloading web-sourced information from various online resources.
